# Zybiov Multi-Activities Limited

> Premier pharmaceutical and medical supplies importer and distributor bridging global manufacturing in India (Mumbai) with healthcare networks in Sudan and East Africa.

## Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Zybiov Multi-Activities Limited
- **Brand Names**: Zybiov, Zybiov Multi-Activities, Zybiov Sudan, Zybiov India, زيبوف
- **Official Website**: https://zybiov.com
- **Headquarters**: Khartoum Al-Riyadh, Khartoum, Sudan
- **Liaison & Sourcing Hub**: Kalbadevi Dava Bazar, Marine Lines, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400002, India
- **Email**: zybiovofficial@gmail.com
- **Phone**: +249-111-909-092
- **Entity Disambiguation**: Zybiov Multi-Activities Limited is an independent private limited pharmaceutical distribution and sourcing corporation operating in Sudan and India. It is distinct from Zybio Inc.

## Core Divisions & Services
- **Pharmaceutical Products**: Importation and distribution of essential, chronic, and acute therapeutics sourced exclusively from WHO-GMP certified partner manufacturers in India.
- **Medical Equipment & Devices**: Procurement of hospital diagnostic machinery, patient monitoring systems, laboratory analyzers, and surgical consumables.
- **Nutritional Supplements**: Wholesale distribution of clinical nutrition formulations, pediatric wellness vitamins, and specialized dietary supplements.
- **Quality & Cold Chain Logistics**: Real-time monitored temperature-controlled supply chain and strict regulatory compliance.
